thematic_fit_momentum.environment_layer: the starting grade (version 5.1, from 2-Oct-26): a score of 80 percent from this week's tilts (A 100, B 75, C 50, D 25, F 0) on the stock's sector (weight 0.5), industry (0.3) and country (0.2; a Neutral country is left out and its weight shared by the other two), plus 20 percent from the sector's 12-month relative strength (0 to 99; a missing reading counts as 50). Every stock's score is then ranked across the whole universe and graded on Richard's curve: top 10 percent A, next 15 percent B, next 25 percent C, next 25 percent D, bottom 25 percent F (tied scores share one grade). Because the grade is a rank, it can move when other stocks' scores or the weekly tilts move, even if this stock's own tilts have not; before 2-Oct-26 the same tilt mean was graded on fixed bands
thematic_fit_momentum.stock_layer: thematic-tailwind exposure weight 1.0 at A or B, 0.5 at C, 0 at D or F; external-force exposure weight 1.0 at A, B, D or F, 0 at C, direction by grade; only thematic, industry and sector tags move the grade (version one), and never a tag naming the stock's own sector or own industry, which the environment layer already scores (D-EMR-26)
thematic_fit_momentum.combination: sum rounded half away from zero, capped at 2 grade steps either way; never above B unless the environment base is B or better

how_these_readings_are_set.tsr_valuation: the Investment Analyst's Modal return (the plausible total shareholder return a year, over eighteen months and three years, at the fair multiple the analyst chose), re-based every night to that night's price; graded on the average of the two re-based returns (one where only one is stated), rounded to one decimal: A 25.0+, B 18.0 to 24.99, C 13.0 to 17.99, D 10.0 to 12.99, F below 10.0 (Richard's anchors: 20 percent is a B). Where there is no Modal return (no conveyor memo yet), the valuation reading (the P/E against the stock's own ten-year history, as a percentile, graded in fixed fifths: 0 to 20 A, 21 to 40 B, 41 to 60 C, 61 to 80 D, 81 to 100 F; Richard, 2-Oct-26) stands in, labelled 'valuation reading only'. It ranks, it never gates; a two-grade disagreement between the two goes to the override list
how_these_readings_are_set.fragility_modifier: (fragility fit - 62) x 0.15, clipped to plus or minus 7.5 points
how_these_readings_are_set.memo_worthy: in the Pool of Stocks Eligible for Portfolio Consideration at the latest month-end reading, and no conveyor memo yet (no memo, an old-scheme memo, or a memo older than 365 days); which of them get memos, and in what order, is the commissioner's, by position on the Ideas Lists
how_these_readings_are_set.entry_merit: bottom-up composite B or better and a recommendation direction of progress or other

entry_timing.text: in the Pool at the latest month-end reading, and Sell-side Momentum, Thematic Fit/Momentum and Technical Momentum C or better; TSR/Valuation ranks but never gates

how_these_readings_are_set.pool_flag: the Pool of Stocks Eligible for Portfolio Consideration (APM - Stage 2 Gate-4 Backtest, signed off 28-Sep-26 and 29-Sep-26), read at the latest month-end, in an Uptrend month-end only: market value EUR 500m or more; the stock's Composite relative strength (Stock RS) 80 or more; its sector's Composite relative strength (Sector RS) 50 or more; the sell-side's net upgrades of next year's sales estimates (SS Sales Net Upgrade Breadth) 0 or more. Month-end readings decide the following month; the daily reading is information
how_these_readings_are_set.alert: a fall of 1 grade or more week on week in any top-down rating of a live holding or Ideas Bench name (information only)
how_these_readings_are_set.rare_one: 5 or more of the eight at A or B, with 6 or more present
how_these_readings_are_set.staleness: bottom-up rating older than 365 days: stale, memo due; weekly reading older than 14 days: weekly run missed; three-year horizon under twelve months: memo due
how_these_readings_are_set.override_life: until the next weekly run's first writer call, or 14 days
how_these_readings_are_set.shrinkage: a thin bottom-up composite is pulled toward the coverage-weighted pool mean in proportion to missing coverage (Richard, 16-Sep-26)

known_gaps: 'stale pin' (a pin older than the latest results date) is not flagged: the nightly data holds the next results date only, not the latest one

row_notes.track: each rating's grade [one, four, twelve] weeks back; a rating with no history is omitted
row_notes.names: master_ratings keys are the machine keys; the names and numbers are in how_these_readings_are_set
row_notes.detail: the environment layer's parts and every movers list are in the weekly top-down file
